summary: The reviewed commit is recoverable through the synchronized remote feature branch, its production code/profile/checkpoint versioning is aligned, its checkpoint hash matches, and v5.7.1-rc3 is an annotated local tag. Release acceptance is blocked because the only archived validation receipt is bound to ancestor fd1e1d0, while subsequent commits changed the audit launcher and its tests; no durable test receipt or completed audit-gate decision is bound to 5bb5a836. Remote publication of the rc3 tag could not be verified. Documentation appropriately continues to call this a candidate requiring an independent audit.

evidence: `git rev-parse HEAD` returned `5bb5a836e30ed0a8b4f6644e3e5f30d680f6ad4e`.
`git remote -v` identifies origin as `https://github.com/dushyant-mishra/Drosophila-sperm-nuclei-segmentation.git`.
`git branch -r --contains HEAD` returned `origin/feature/v5.7.1-annotation-tolerant-unet`; `git for-each-ref refs/heads` showed the corresponding local branch at 5bb5a83 with no ahead/behind marker.
`git status --short --branch` reported detached HEAD and only the active untracked audit directory `audits/runs/20260821-v571-remediation-acceptance-rc3/`.
`git diff --stat` and `git diff --cached --stat` were empty for tracked files.

`git diff --name-status fd1e1d0..HEAD` showed only `audits/validation/v571_fd1e1d0_validation.md`, `scripts/run_multi_agent_audit.ps1`, and `tests/test_agent_audit_framework.py`; production scientific code, profile, and checkpoint were unchanged after the recorded production validation.
`sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:4705` defines `_VERSION = "v5.7.1-body-width"`.
`utils/tune_parameters_Saturnv5_7_1.py:36-44` uses the same version and loads `sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py`.
`production_profiles/saturn_v5_7_1_model_c_epoch003.json:29-33` selects U-Net primary, names the epoch003 checkpoint, records its production-candidate role, and declares dual-head output.
`production_profiles/saturn_v5_7_1_model_c_epoch003.json:213-226` identifies pipeline `v5.7.1-dual-head-width` and describes the fixed Model C epoch 3 configuration.

`certutil -hashfile model_checkpoints\v571_model_c_dual_head_epoch003.pt SHA256` returned `7d49031dbcce31f0600c44146d9b5282b0df6e28bb1fc1bdde6ef2146ed15d25`, matching `production_profiles/saturn_v5_7_1_model_c_epoch003.json:32` and `V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:11`.

`audits/validation/v571_fd1e1d0_validation.md:3-18` records compilation, 205 tests, tuner self-check, and diff-check results for commit `fd1e1d0dfc427f2196cd6ec5566309e814dfacc9`, not reviewed commit 5bb5a836.
`git log --oneline --stat fd1e1d0..HEAD` shows later changes to `scripts/run_multi_agent_audit.ps1` and `tests/test_agent_audit_framework.py` in commits 4b66a87 and 5bb5a83.

Focused command `.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q tests/test_agent_audit_framework.py` could not start because the read-only environment provided no writable temporary directory; pytest raised `FileNotFoundError: No usable temporary directory found`.
`audits/runs/20260821-v571-remediation-acceptance-rc3/manifest.json:3-5` correctly identifies this run, claim, and reviewed commit.
`audits/runs/20260821-v571-remediation-acceptance-rc3/manifest.json:22-25` has `completed_at_utc: null` and an empty `role_exit_codes` object.
Directory inspection found no current `gate_summary.json` or `decision.json`; the entire current run directory is untracked according to `git status --short --branch`.
`audits/claims_registry.json:56-59` still points to the earlier failed diagnostic audit and records `gate_passed: false`.
`git cat-file -t v5.7.1-rc3` returned `tag`, confirming an annotated rather than lightweight tag.
`git rev-parse v5.7.1-rc3^{}` resolved to reviewed commit `5bb5a836e30ed0a8b4f6644e3e5f30d680f6ad4e`.

`git tag -v v5.7.1-rc3` displayed the annotated tag object and message `Saturn v5.7.1 acceptance candidate 3`; it also reported `no signature found`, which does not negate annotation but means cryptographic signature verification is unavailable.
`git ls-remote --tags origin refs/tags/v5.7.1-rc3 refs/tags/v5.7.1-rc3^{}` failed because network access to github.com:443 was unavailable.
Local `git show-ref --tags` confirms only the local annotated tag object `48132996d362ab7181b86e470ee34c04b1f9b477`; it cannot prove the tag was pushed.
`git status --short --ignored` identified `.venv/` and current audit logs as ignored; no microscopy image stack was executed.
`.gitignore:14-23` excludes temporary/large image, log, batch, and archive formats; `.gitignore:25-47` excludes generated analysis and tuning outputs.

The tracked checkpoint is 4,634,914 bytes, and tracked large PNG files are located under documented `docs/readme_assets` or `audits/evidence` paths; inspection found no unexpected untracked production data outside the active audit run.
`git ls-files | rg -i '(secret|credential|api[_-]?key|token|\.env$|private[_-]?key|\.pem$|\.p12$)'` returned no tracked filename matches.
`.gitignore:1-2` explicitly excludes `gemini_api_key.txt`.
`README.md:67-82` labels the pipeline and profile as production-candidate components.
`V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:128-134` reports the automated validation results.
`V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:136-141` states that a fresh independent seven-role audit on a clean pushed commit is still required, avoiding an assertion of completed release validation.
`V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:83` and `V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:98-99` explicitly reject genotype inference from one specimen per group.
`git branch -vv` showed the active v5.7.1 feature branch at reviewed commit 5bb5a83 and the prior audit branch at 8c1f9f5; `git log` establishes 8c1f9f5 as an ancestor of the reviewed candidate.
Older v5.7 and v5.6 feature branches remain separately named and do not replace the reviewed v5.7.1 remote ref.

findings.title: No durable validation receipt is bound to the reviewed commit
findings.impact: The release steward cannot reproduce or later prove that the modified audit launcher and its new regression tests passed at 5bb5a836. This violates the requirement that tests be run on the reviewed commit.
evidence: `audits/validation/v571_fd1e1d0_validation.md:3` binds validation to ancestor fd1e1d0.
`audits/validation/v571_fd1e1d0_validation.md:11-18` contains the only archived command results.
`git log --oneline --stat fd1e1d0..HEAD` shows post-receipt modifications to the audit launcher and `tests/test_agent_audit_framework.py`.
Focused pytest could not execute in this read-only session because no writable temporary directory was available.
findings.recommendation: On an unchanged checkout of 5bb5a836, run at least the audit-framework tests plus the documented compilation, full pytest, tuner self-check, and `git diff --check`; archive an append-only receipt recording the exact commit, commands, environment, results, and artifact hashes.

findings.title: Current audit run has no completed gate result or immutable decision
findings.impact: The claim remains `implemented`, and no accepted decision for this exact commit can be recovered. Publication as an accepted production release would be premature.
evidence: `audits/runs/20260821-v571-remediation-acceptance-rc3/manifest.json:22-25` shows the audit is incomplete.
No `gate_summary.json` or `decision.json` exists in the current run directory.
`audits/claims_registry.json:56-59` still records the earlier blocked diagnostic audit.
`git status --short --branch` shows the current audit directory is untracked.
findings.recommendation: After all required independent reviews are complete, run the documented gate validator against this exact run and commit. If it passes, create and archive the append-only decision and update the claim registry through the prescribed coordinator workflow before release publication.

findings.title: Remote publication of the rc3 tag is unverified
findings.impact: The candidate commit is remotely recoverable by branch, but consumers cannot rely on the rc3 release label until its remote presence is confirmed.
evidence: The local annotated `v5.7.1-rc3` tag peels to 5bb5a836.
`git ls-remote --tags origin ...` failed because network access was unavailable.
The commit itself is contained by `origin/feature/v5.7.1-annotation-tolerant-unet`.
findings.recommendation: From an authorized networked environment, verify that `refs/tags/v5.7.1-rc3` and its peeled commit exist on origin. Do not push or alter the tag without explicit authorization.

findings.title: Annotated candidate tag is unsigned
findings.impact: The tag is an immutable Git object locally, but its author identity cannot be cryptographically verified with `git tag -v`.
evidence: `git tag -v v5.7.1-rc3` displayed the annotation and returned `error: no signature found`.
`git cat-file -t v5.7.1-rc3` returned `tag`.
findings.recommendation: If release policy requires provenance stronger than an annotated tag plus archived hashes, create a signed final release tag only after the audit gate passes and explicit authorization is granted.

limitations: Other reviewers' individual review JSON files were not inspected or used.
No full image stack was run.
Focused pytest could not start because the managed read-only environment had no writable temporary directory.
Network restrictions prevented direct verification of remote tag refs.
The current audit gate cannot be evaluated until the remaining review artifacts and this repository-release review are assembled.
recommended_follow_up: Complete and validate the current seven-role audit run without changing the reviewed commit.
Archive the resulting gate summary and decision append-only, then update the claim registry if and only if the gate passes.
Verify the annotated rc3 tag on origin from an authorized networked environment.
Retain production release status until these blocking repository-provenance gaps are closed.
